choice: Close universal life0 transfer/default-uniform. Use the original-greedy ring as a finite replacement-positive body, with separate_seeds as a prespecified contrasting body, to test history-specific response and distinguish body-associated state from extracellular inventory.

evidence.finite_transfer: 4/8 pairs only compact/double_lobe; uniform not default
evidence.positive: Original and uniform ring both pass four64 windows under original tapes. True replacement, finite256 only. Parent choice is post hoc, not independent validation.
evidence.visual_PI: Viewed both actual body_ring.png and body_separate_seeds.png: persistent ring hole with redistribution versus four shrinking separated clusters; no newly evolved morphology claim.

question: At fixed rule and immediate greedy response, does the order of equal spatial resource exposure produce a future-direction-specific retained body state, and does the effect follow the body-associated package or the extracellular P/F packet?
invariants: Only external input schedule and the declared clock256 packet crossover change. Original reference deletion (layout off), current greedy, g2_p0_c0 kernels/config, command0, native/pump/admit/basal prices, capacity, half-life64, actual old inventories and complete inherited ledgers remain. Do not add uniform, a writer, learning, or a parameter sweep.

maps.center: Use each original life0-fixed map fixed_P/fixed_F already in the saved parent, not recomputed from its current body.
maps.distance: Exactly4 grid cells, frozen before all forward calls; no feasibility-based adjustment.
maps.input: P and F are colocated at each phase, original per-step gross input. Existing inventories never move with source maps. External positioning work is not priced; maps are experimental environments, not organism actions.

histories.H_U: native129..160 down;161..192 up;193..256 center. Last exposure direction up.
histories.H_D: native129..160 up;161..192 down;193..256 center. Last exposure direction down.

protocol.exposure: H_U and H_D each receive exactly32 steps at each of the two identical maps in reverse order, then64 common-center steps. Integrated per-grid added P and F equal between those histories. H_C has equal gross, not equal spatial history. Call193..256 a common interval, not complete washout.
protocol.history_execution: Each of four exact clock128 parents is cloned to all three histories and each runs128 native once. Preserve full clock160/192/256 ready states. No old acquisition or future replay.
protocol.crossover: At actual clock256 of H_U/H_D, fully clone each body-associated state B in {H_U,H_D}. For each B create two conditions receiving actual extracellular arrays precursor and fuel from R in {H_U,H_D}. Copy both P/F arrays together, byte-identical to the named actual donor. Own-packet controls pass the same copy path (sham). Everything else in the recipient state, world, cumulative history and observer labels remains from B. Then independently fork each condition to probe U or D.
protocol.body_package: Includes rho, intracellular energy, original controller/physical state and material labels, not geometry alone. Heat/waste/dead_energy and cumulative ledgers stay with body history; they are inert in this no-recycling protocol. Do not transfer covert history fields that the next controller can read. Freeze and document the exact state fields read by current greedy/native/pump.
protocol.accounting: The crossed pair B=U,R=D and B=D,R=U conserves total P/F across the pair. Each branch records actual removed and received arrays and their material/fuel-energy sums as an external intervention ledger. Never normalize, refill, clip, debit newborns, or erase old cumulative balances. Own-PF sham has exact zero exchange. Crossed physical totals differ per individual and this is part of the treatment. No physical transport-work price is assigned to this laboratory exchange, so it is not an available biological action or a free learned capability.
protocol.neutral: H_C complete clock256 state is cloned to U/D probes with its own P/F and identical sham-copy bookkeeping. No remaking a neutral body.
protocol.probe: native257..384 fixed up or fixed down map. Original finite horizon384 is retained, all128 steps executed, two predetermined64 windows. No re-selection of input, phase or end time.
protocol.total: 4 parents × (3 histories×128 + (2 body histories×2 P/F donors×2 probe directions +2 neutral probes)×128) =6656 science native;12 history legs and40 probe futures.
protocol.labels: Keep true founder/L128 inherited accounting. At clock256 before exchange register body L256=rho and a separate born-after256 observer0. Carry actual K and actor/rule survival; born updates only the new-tissue account. P/F swap leaves all material-body cohort labels unchanged; no labels or future outcomes enter policy.

contrasts.body_interaction: For each parent and each fixed P/F donor R and metric Y: I_B(R)=[Y(B_U,R,probeU)-Y(B_D,R,probeU)]-[Y(B_U,R,probeD)-Y(B_D,R,probeD)]. Positive denotes last-exposure matching; negative is an anti-match effect, never relabel post hoc.
contrasts.resource_interaction: For each fixed body history B: I_R(B)=[Y(B,R_U,probeU)-Y(B,R_D,probeU)]-[Y(B,R_U,probeD)-Y(B,R_D,probeD)]. Report jointly with I_B; not a natural mediation percentage.
contrasts.metrics: Predeclare probe bodytime and actual post256 tissue retained at384 as co-primary history-response metrics. Also report final M/E, deltaM/deltaE from256, uptake, oldL256, founder, actual born/death, fees and cumulative experiment costs from128. No composite score or uptake-only win.
contrasts.meaningful: Direction-specific body-associated response requires both I_B co-primary metrics to agree in sign under BOTH P/F donors, separately for each ring parent; give all raw values and both seeds. A positive matching pattern alone is not a net adaptive advantage.
contrasts.adaptive_guard: A beneficial matching interpretation additionally requires on-diagonal matching probes versus neutral same-probe reference not to reduce finalM, finalE or probe bodytime (1e-8 accounting tolerance) in both directions for each claimed parent, and actual post256 tissue must improve. Retain history costs and altered initial state; do not call an interaction a learned controller.
contrasts.maintenance: Report born-death>=-1e-8, deltaE>=-1e-8,minM>=32 in each probe64 window and both jointly; zero-tolerance sensitivity. Histories/negative body failures remain included. Do not carry old ring maintenance success onto this new challenge.
contrasts.scope: Two previously selected positive ring parents and two related negative-shape parents, not independent evolutionary replicates or a held-out confirmation. No specific mutation, shape, intracellular-energy or stored writer is causally isolated by the body package.

records.every_native: Unique clock and leg, complete scalar physical/cost/input/export/arrears/born/death/tag ledgers; no interpolation of missing fields.
records.receipts: History boundary actual160/192/256 and probe1/8/64/128, include pre-choice current-state fields, native and pump receipts, and full exact exchange manifest at256.
records.visual: View ring and separated actual acquired states, full probe curves and predeclared first-parent fields at256/257/320/384. Reuse real raw frames; do not claim all animated trajectories were inspected.

budget.checks: Four saved128 parents: original next step versus schedule-wrapper using exactly original next input (2 each=8 native). No perturbation-dependent tuning. Map gross/order equality, PF pair conservation, roundtrip/sham all pure-array0native. Freeze source bindings and plan before first native.
budget.control: Check research.desired_state and started immediately before job. Stop on paused/stopped. PI read running/true this turn. All old balances sealed.
budget.failures: All attempted/returned/settled calls and attempts charged. Unknown completed status is never replayed. Same-job explicit recovery only from exact completed checkpoints, preserving original failure/source amendments. No second job, budget borrowing or timer.

handoff: Implement and actually run this finite single job. Routine shared short leaf; once completed give PI actual next-choice result, merging paper/projection existing items. No training, amplitude/window/price scan or automatic extension. If prerequisites fail, preserve exact blocker instead of changing the scientific treatment.
